texto: The verb in the form of a dictionary + **こと に しました** = I decided: **まいにち うんどう する こと に しました** (I decided to exercise every day).
The decision is made by you.
A dictionary-shaped verb + **こと に なりました** = has been decided: **らいねん、 にほん で はたらく こと に なりました** (it has been decided that I will work in Japan next year).
The decision comes from the company, from another person or from the circumstances, not just from you.
